howto.what: 当你说出“ultrawork”或“ulw”,Claude 进入严格模式:先写测试证明问题,再修复,最后用真实操作验证,并全程记录。
howto.when: 当提示词里出现“ultrawork”或“ulw”时触发(在 omo on Codex 环境中自动注入引导)。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式修复登录页的报错
say.note: 进入严格流程:先复现、再修复、最后验证。

say.text: 进入 ulw 模式,为这个 API 添加一个端点
say.note: 按层级评估工作量并完成测试与真实调用验证。

say.text: ultrawork:重构订单模块并保持测试通过
say.note: 会先写失败测试,再做重构并采集证据。

howto.what_en: When you say 'ultrawork' or 'ulw', Claude switches to a strict mode: it writes a failing test to prove the problem, then fixes it, then verifies with a real-surface action, logging every step.
howto.when_en: Triggers when 'ultrawork' or 'ulw' appears in your prompt (in the omo-on-Codex environment, a hook injects a bootstrap pointing to this skill).

say_en.text: Fix the login page error in ultrawork mode.
say_en.note: Starts the strict flow: reproduce, fix, verify.

say_en.text: Enter ulw mode and add an endpoint to this API.
say_en.note: Sizes the tier and runs tests plus a real call.

say_en.text: Ultrawork: refactor the order module and keep tests green.
say_en.note: Writes a failing test first, refactors, collects evidence.
